stem: Veronica wants to add a call to action to the end of her essay. Which sentence should she insert after sentence 25 to provide an effective call to action?

options.label: A
options.text: All parents should teach their children about establishing good credit.

options.label: B
options.text: Teenagers often overspend before they head out into the workforce or off to college.

options.label: C
options.text: All teens should take the simple steps necessary to begin building good credit.

options.label: D
options.text: If I can earn better credit, I can do anything.
